english.note: Use 飯 as the all-purpose colloquial noun for an ordinary meal, especially when focusing on the food eaten.
Use this for the food or meal being served, especially in contexts such as asking what there is for dinner.

examples.english: We’ll go see a movie after the meal.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 sin1 heoi3 tai2 hei3

examples.english: What food is there for dinner tonight?
examples.jyutping: gam1 maan1 jau5 me1 faan6 aa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for cooked rice served as food.

examples.english: I want to eat rice tonight.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 faan6
